A '''consortium''' of [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] operated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They owned the [[Action IV transport]] [[Asagov Raider|''Cekbar Servant'']] until it was stolen by the [[Saurton]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Miktiss]].
